name: CEF (ArcSight)
description: Receive events in Common Event Format from ArcSight and compatible tools

setup_guide.title: Forward CEF events
steps: Configure your SIEM or device to forward CEF-formatted events via HTTP
Set the destination URL to the Hakuna webhook URL below
Send one CEF line per HTTP POST body, or multiple lines separated by newlines
Include the Bearer token in the Authorization header

sample_payload: CEF:0|Security|Firewall|1.0|200|Connection Blocked|7|src=192.168.1.100 dst=10.0.0.1 act=deny suser=admin rt=Mar 15 2024 14:30:00 cat=network msg=Suspicious outbound connection blocked
